% ================ SLIDE 03: External parameters and normalizations ================
% Source note: Evaluate Calibration Strategy, 6ac158c6-38ac-83ec-b89d-5a50c4a990b6. Read 12 October 2026. Local reference_conversation.md preserves the equations. The embedded pseudocode object was unavailable. Equations were checked against Codes/Calibration_R1/Plan/V6_parameter_identifying_moments.tex and Do/calibration.py.
% Source note: 
% Source note: Oberfield and Raval (2021), Micro Data and Macro Technology, Econometrica 89(2), 703–732. https://doi.org/10.3982/ECTA12807 and https://ezraoberfield.github.io/CESAggregation.pdf. Abstract and pp. 703–705 report capital–labor elasticity 0.5–0.7 for US manufacturing. rho=2 uses sigma=0.5 as a maintained analogy to a different V6 input margin. Do/rho_selection.md records Gechert et al. (2022) as additional evidence.
% Source note: The retained 1.61 benchmark follows the project source audit for De Loecker, Eeckhout and Unger (2020), 2016 US sales-weighted markup. https://doi.org/10.1093/qje/qjz041. The model has a homogeneous intermediate producer. Firm aggregation, marginal-cost definition and a constant 2009–2024 markup remain assumptions. See Do/reference_audit.md and the Plan production literature review. The 3.5 case is diagnostic and has no adopted external calibration status.
% Source note: 
% Source note: Run: 2009–2024. All 16 dates are fitting observations. One annual period is a conditional production convention. The full OLG generation mapping and GE calibration are outside this run.

% Source note: 
% Source note: Do/calibration.py: sequential. Each equation regresses Δlog C on (1-rho)log G_Q without an intercept. Labor uses observed annual L_t in the conditional extension. These estimates seed diagnosis, not the final joint path. P5 differences contain the same information as P4 levels and must not be counted again.
% Source note:

% ================ SLIDE 10: Joint production fit ================
% Source note: Evaluate Calibration Strategy, 6ac158c6-38ac-83ec-b89d-5a50c4a990b6. Read 12 October 2026. Local reference_conversation.md preserves the equations. The embedded pseudocode object was unavailable. Equations were checked against Codes/Calibration_R1/Plan/V6_parameter_identifying_moments.tex and Do/calibration.py.
% Source note: 
% Source note: Do/calibration.py: joint_fit. Objective = mean[((Q-I-wH/a)/Q)^2] + mean[rX^2] + mean[rL^2], where rX = log CX-log alpha-(1-rho)(log AXbar+xi log N(a)), analogously for rL. Conditional on a, intercept and slope regressions solve exactly. The grid profiles log a and refines all interior local minima. Sequential differences are not additional moment blocks.
% Source note: 
% Source note: Run: 2009–2024. All 16 dates are fitting observations. One annual period is a conditional production convention. The full OLG generation mapping and GE calibration are outside this run.
% Source note: 
% Source note: Notation: phi denotes skilled production allocation, not the portfolio wedge varphi. theta=1/mu. Technology scale units follow trillion 2017 USD and million workers.
% Source note: 
% Source note: Source hashes: Slides/.build/slide_data.json, provenance.
\begin{frame}[plain]
\begin{tikzpicture}[remember picture,overlay]
\begin{scope}[shift={(current page.north west)}]
\node[anchor=north west,inner sep=0pt,outer sep=0pt,align=left,text width=29.6cm,text=blue,font=\sffamily\fontsize{11.5}{14.145}\selectfont\bfseries] at (1.2cm,-0.6cm) {JOINT ESTIMATION PHASE};
\node[anchor=north west,inner sep=0pt,outer sep=0pt,align=left,text width=29.6cm,text=ink,font=\sffamily\fontsize{26.5}{32.595}\selectfont\bfseries] at (1.2cm,-1.5cm) {Joint production fit};
\node[anchor=north west,inner sep=0pt,outer sep=0pt,align=left,text width=29.6cm,text=gray,font=\sffamily\fontsize{13.2}{16.236}\selectfont] at (1.2cm,-3.05cm) {2009--2024. Conditional diagnostic: $\mu=3.5$, $\vartheta=1/\mu=0.2857$, $\rho=2$};

% Source note: Do/Spillover_Diagnosis/results/summary.json, mapping_sensitivity.csv and annual_mechanism.csv. Native Julia production recovery and independent wage derivative checks passed. These checks establish consistency of the production implementation, not empirical identification or a full GE solution.
% Source note: At rho=2, xi-nu = -slope(log premium on log N) - 2 slope(log X/L on log N). Contributions are -0.0747888 and -1.7448188. The manuscript restriction is xi_u>nu_u>nu_b>=0. The weaker production-only screen xi>nu>=0 already fails. Nu itself is positive.

See Do/reference_audit.md and the Plan production literature review. The 3.5 case is diagnostic and has no adopted external calibration status.

Abstract and pp. 703–705 report capital–labor elasticity 0.5–0.7 for US manufacturing. rho=2 uses sigma=0.5 as a maintained analogy to a different V6 input margin.
